## business-analyst

- **Mode:** primary
- **Source:** `src/agents/business-analyst.md`

Refines product and business requests into approved, ready-to-create functional tickets without implementing them

## coder

- **Mode:** primary
- **Source:** `src/agents/coder.md`

Implements an approved ticket from its functional requirements and selected technical direction, then verifies the change

## documenter

- **Mode:** primary
- **Source:** `src/agents/documenter.md`

Generates or updates project technical documentation for any repository using the documented taxonomy and checks; uv is used only as the preferred way to invoke the render tool (properdocs). Trigger on "generate docs", "create documentation", "write docs", "document the project", "update the documentation".

## reviewer

- **Mode:** primary
- **Source:** `src/agents/reviewer.md`

Reviews a pull request, a local diff, or the current state of the code against its description, linked ticket, project standards, security, performance, tests, documentation, and CI status, then produces a review comment and a decision. Trigger on "review pr", "review pull request", "review branch", "check this pr", "review diff", "review my changes", "review current branch", "review code", "review these files".

- **Mode:** subagent
- **Hidden:** yes (delegated subagent)

- **Mode:** subagent
- **Hidden:** yes (delegated subagent)
